purpose: Assess source-qualified constrained-timescale candidates against the unchanged independent Hussein profile
eligibility: Require numerical_pass and source-width pass separately for each case before reading the holdout. Retain every ineligible case with its rejection reason, without a held-out score.
holdout: Unchanged reference.json; all 201 radial points over eta=0..0.2, decay coefficient, half-width slope, entrainment alpha; all must satisfy 20% relative screening criterion
baseline_comparison: Also compare each new source-state profile with its original unconstrained normal-production state; no baseline fitting or profile rescaling
uncertainty: Engineering screen, not measurement confidence interval
